name: price-action-backtest-plugin
description: Agent-native price action backtesting workflow for technical analysis, signal validation, and QuantSeras-style visualization reports.

interface.shortDescription: Backtest price-based technical strategies and render beautiful reports.
interface.longDescription: A Claude Code and Codex plugin scaffold for a reproducible price-action and technical-analysis backtesting workflow. The intended workflow will read OHLCV CSV files, compute common indicators, run deterministic signal backtests with costs and lookahead controls, export artifacts, and create QuantSeras-style dark HTML reports as later implementation tasks are completed.
